title: Choose the Technique That Fits
short: Match the tool to the material: palaces for order, chunking for numbers, sketches for structure, acronyms for first letters, songs for exact wording, narration for stories.
trouble: Using one favorite trick for everything.

practice.q: Which tool fits the order of the 13 original colonies, north to south?
practice.a: A memory palace (or an acrostic, for the first letters).
steps: A memory palace keeps a long order.
